about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who I am
about.bio1: I'm a Fullstack Developer based in Málaga. I currently work in the R&D department at Solbyte S.L., building solutions focused on artificial intelligence using PHP, Laravel, Filament, and automation workflows with n8n.
about.bio2: Before joining Solbyte I spent a year as a freelance developer, building full-stack web applications with React, Node.js and MySQL. I'm passionate about solving real problems with clean code and well-thought-out solutions.

project1.title: Soti Barber Studio
project1.description: Fullstack appointment manager for barber shops. Clients can book, cancel and manage their appointments online. Built with React, Node.js and MySQL.

project2.title: MotoStyleHub
project2.description: Social platform for motorcycle fashion designers. Users can register, create profiles and share their custom moto designs with the community. Stack: Node.js, MySQL and EJS.

project3.title: Sync User Service
project3.description: REST API in Node.js and TypeScript for synchronizing users in PostgreSQL. Features Zod validation, health check endpoint, correlation IDs for tracing, and Docker Compose deployment.
